title: Annual Reward Earning Parameters across Northgate Membership Tiers
content:
Annual Reward is earned only on the Plus tiers of Northgate Memberships; every other tier earns at a rate of 0.

| Tier | Annual Reward rate (percent of qualifying purchases) | Maximum Annual Reward in one membership year (USD) | Purchases by household and add-on cardholders earn to the membership |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Northgate Club Membership | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Northgate Business Membership | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 2.0 | 1000.00 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 2.0 | 1500.00 | Yes |

## Basis and exclusions (same at every tier)

- **What the rate is applied to:** the pre-tax net price of the purchase after instant savings.
- **Merchandise classes that never earn:** gasoline; tobacco and alcohol; Northgate Shop Card and gift card purchases.

## Notes

- A rate of 0 and a cap of 0.00 mean the tier earns no Annual Reward.
- The two Plus tiers earn at the same rate, 2.0 percent, but their caps differ: 1000.00 dollars a membership year at Club Plus and 1500.00 dollars at Business Plus.
- Only the Plus tiers credit the purchases of household and add-on cardholders to the membership.

## Hypothetical worked figure

A qualifying purchase line with a pre-tax net price after instant savings of 250.00 dollars, on a Plus tier, earns 2.0 percent of 250.00, that is 5.00 dollars. The same line on Northgate Club Membership earns nothing, the rate being 0.
